en: A black-and-white vintage postcard shows a central European square lined with ornate historic buildings. In the foreground, people stand on cobblestone pavement near a lamppost, with horse-drawn carts visible. Notably, there is a large church tower or historic building dominating the skyline. The architectural style is typical of Dutch or northern European cities, and storefront signs are also visible.
